Protocol to use.
In this release, spark supports amps, fix, nvfix and xml.
Defaults to amps. spark also supports json as a synonym for
amps in this release.

Specifies whether to use an SSL-secured connection (tcps
URI scheme).
Values: false/0/no or true/1/yes
Default: false

Custom connection URI parameters to be passed in the URI
query string.
For example:
tcp_nodelay=true&tcp_sndbuf=8192
